issue_context.title: [Bug] [Doctor] db consistency fix function not working
issue_context.body:
doctor **check-db-consistency** task use `models.DeleteOrphanedObjects()` witch does not work

ref: https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/pull/15658#issuecomment-829474478

tested with `mariadb Ver 15.1`

gitea v1.13.7, v1.14.1 & master have same issue:

v13: `Error: Unsupported type`
v14&master: ` - [C] Error: %!v(MISSING) whilst deleting orphaned objects`
comments: `%!v(MISSING)` should be fixed by #15658 and the underlaying bug in `models.DeleteOrphanedObjects()` gets fixed with #15657.

review_comments: This test should add some orphaned objects.
Yes just add an pull emtry with repo&issue id = 10000 and we should catch it

Since all tests shared the only one fixture directory, I don't think we should change the fixture to an inconsistent state. And also I cannot find any function to create an empty pull request into database.
Well we have to exec custom sql. Simple "INSERT INTO x () VALUES(1000,1000);" so i do testing manualy too
